greeting.zh: 您好，这里是 {company} 技术支持。

menu.zh: 请问今天是哪方面需要帮忙？直接打字告诉我就可以，例如「投影机没画面」「麦克风有回音」。需要技术员的话回复 0。
menu.en: What can we help you with today? Just type what is happening, for example "projector shows no image" or "microphone echo". Reply 0 if you would like a technician.

after_hours.zh: 现在是下班时间，我可以先陪您做一些基本排查；需要技术员的话，我们上班后第一时间联系您。如果活动正在进行、情况紧急，请回复「紧急」。
after_hours.en: We are outside office hours. I can walk you through the basic checks now, and if you need a technician we will contact you first thing when we open. If an event is in progress and it is urgent, reply URGENT.

fallback.zh:
收到。这个情况我先转给同事看一下，他会回复您。
方便的话，告诉我设备的品牌型号和现在的状况，或者拍张照片，处理会更快。也欢迎 email 我们（{email}）或在群组里留言。
fallback.en:
Got it. I am passing this to a colleague, who will reply to you.
If you can, tell me the brand and model and what it is doing now, or send a photo; it speeds things up. You are also welcome to email us at {email} or post in the group.

handoff.zh: 好的，我请技术员直接联系您，请稍等。方便的话，先发一张设备和接线的照片，他一看就能判断。
handoff.en: Sure, I will have a technician contact you directly. One moment. If you can, send a photo of the equipment and cabling so they can assess it straight away.

escalate.zh: 如果还是不行，欢迎 email 我们（{email}），或在群组里留言，我们会马上回复您。
escalate.en: If it is still not working, you are welcome to email us at {email} or post in the group, and we will reply right away.

visit_received.zh: 收到，谢谢。技术员会联系您确认上门时间。还有要补充的资料或照片，直接发过来就行。
visit_received.en: Received, thank you. A technician will contact you to confirm the visit. Send any extra details or photos here.

suggest.zh: 您说的是下面哪一种情况？
suggest.en: Which of these is closest to what you are seeing?

choose_issue.zh: 明白。是下面哪一种情况？
choose_issue.en: Got it. Which of these is closest to what you are seeing?

option_none.en: None of these, I will describe it

describe.zh: 没问题，请直接告诉我：是什么设备、现在是什么情况。方便的话拍张照片。
describe.en: No problem. Tell me which equipment it is and what it is doing now. A photo helps if you can.

other_prompt.zh: 好的，请直接告诉我发生了什么事，文字、照片、语音都可以。我会转给我们的同事，由他亲自回复您。
other_prompt.en: Of course. Tell me what happened, in text, photos or a voice note. I will pass it to a colleague, who will reply to you personally.

other_received.zh: 收到了，已经转给同事，他会尽快回复您。还有要补充的直接发过来就行。
other_received.en: Received, and passed to a colleague who will get back to you shortly. Send anything else you want to add here.

solved.zh: 太好了，解决了就好。之后再有什么状况，随时在这里找我们。
solved.en: Great, glad that sorted it. If anything else comes up, message us here any time.

contact_also.zh: 您也可以随时 email 我们（{email}），或在群组里留言。
contact_also.en: You can also email us at {email} or post in the group at any time.

question.zh: 请问今天是哪方面需要帮忙？点一个选项，或者直接打字告诉我也可以。
question.en: What can we help you with today? Tap an option, or just type what is happening.

label.zh: 电视、显示屏或 LED 屏

label.en: Laptop will not show on the big screen
Control panel or the whole system

reply.zh:
好的，我来帮您安排。请告诉我：
1) 公司名称和地址
2) 联系人和电话
3) 是什么设备、什么情况
4) 方便的日期和时间
有照片的话也一起发来。
reply.en:
Sure, let me arrange that. Please tell me:
1) Company name and address
2) Contact person and phone number
3) Which equipment and what is happening
4) A date and time that suits you
Photos help too.

reply.zh: 好的，请直接告诉我发生了什么事，文字、照片、语音都可以。我会转给我们的同事，由他亲自回复您。
reply.en: Of course. Tell me what happened, in text, photos or a voice note. I will pass it to a colleague, who will reply to you personally.

reply.zh: 明白，已标记为紧急并通知值班技术员。请马上发给我：公司名、地址、联系电话、现场情况，有照片更好。他会尽快打给您。
reply.en: Understood. I have marked this as urgent and alerted the on-call technician. Please send right away: company name, address, contact number and what is happening, with photos if you can. They will call you as soon as possible.

reply.zh:
询价请告诉我们：
1) 场地类型和大小（会议室 / 礼堂 / 课室 / 店面）
2) 需要的功能（投影、LED 屏、音响、视频会议、中控）
3) 预算范围和时间
我们会安排免费现场勘察后报价。
reply.en:
For a quotation please tell us:
1) Venue type and size (meeting room / hall / classroom / shop)
2) What you need (projection, LED wall, audio, video conferencing, control)
3) Budget range and timeline
We arrange a free site survey before quoting.

reply.zh: 保修查询请提供：公司名、设备型号、安装或购买日期（或发票号）。技术员核对后回复保修状态。
reply.en: For warranty please send: company name, equipment model, installation or purchase date (or invoice number). A technician will check and confirm.

title.zh: 电视、显示屏或 LED 屏

title.en: Laptop will not show on the big screen
Control panel or the whole system

greeting.zh: {name} 您好，这里是 {company} 技术支持。您是我们的重点客户，技术员已同步收到您的信息。
greeting.en: Hello {name}, this is {company} technical support. You are a priority customer and our technicians have been alerted to your message.

escalate.zh: 如果还是不行，直接回复 0，值班技术员会优先联系您；也可以 email {email} 或在群组里留言。
escalate.en: If it is still not working, reply 0 and the on-call technician will contact you first. You can also email {email} or post in the group.

reply.zh:
价格和供货要由同事了解您的需要后再报给您，我这里没办法直接报价。麻烦告诉我：
1) 设备的品牌型号，或者想实现什么功能
2) 场地类型和大小
3) 希望什么时候要
我会转给负责的同事，由他回复您。也可以 email 我们（{email}）。
reply.en:
Pricing and availability come from a colleague once we understand what you need, so I cannot quote here. Could you tell me:
1) The brand and model, or what you want to achieve
2) The venue type and size
3) When you need it
I will pass it to the right colleague, who will reply to you. You can also email us at {email}.

reply.zh: 不客气！还有其他问题随时发给我们。
reply.en: You're welcome! Message us any time if anything else comes up.

reply.zh: 好的。还有需要随时发消息给我们。
reply.en: OK. Message us any time you need anything.

reply.zh: 太好了，问题解决了就好。之后再有状况随时找我们。
reply.en: Great, glad it is sorted. Reach out any time if it happens again.

ai.system_prompt: You are the first-line technical support assistant of an audio-visual (AV) installation and maintenance company. Reply in the customer's language (Chinese or English), briefly, in numbered steps. Only give safe checks a non-technical office user can do: power, cables, input source, volume, settings, restarting devices. Never tell the customer to open equipment, touch internal wiring, climb to ceiling mounts or do electrical work; for those, say a technician must attend. Never quote prices, discounts, warranty decisions or arrival times; say a technician will confirm. Use only the business facts provided; if something is not covered, ask for brand, model, exact symptom and a photo. End with: reply 3 to arrange a technician visit.
ai.facts: {company} AV technician company. Services: meeting room AV installation and maintenance, projectors and LED walls, audio systems and microphones, video conferencing rooms (Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms), control systems and automation, event rental support. Brands commonly supported: Epson, Sony, Panasonic, BenQ projectors; Shure, Sennheiser microphones; Yamaha, Bose, JBL audio; Logitech, Poly, Yealink, Crestron, Extron conferencing and control. Office hours Mon-Sat 9:00-18:00. Emergency on-call for events in progress. Call-out and repair costs are confirmed by a technician; a free site survey is offered for new projects.
